Phil's custom (CMS) checks, rewritten for Paratext 10: Short Verse 1, Report of Titles, Report of Nested Styles, Reference without markers, Report of Poetry Errors and Footnotes (). Each check appears in the Checks panel, and Tools > Phils Custom (cms) Checks... opens a window where you set a check's options, run it and read its report. Click a reference in the report to go to it.
